subject: Quick note about fallersfurniture.com
body:
Hi there,

Faller's has been serving Clarion since 1847 - that's a rare kind of trust to build. While looking at your site, I noticed your meta description only mentions "Clarion, PA" even though your title tag lists Clarion, Shippenville, and Knox - which means Shippenville/Knox searches may not be showing your listing as clearly as they should. I also didn't see a blog or buying-guide section, which is usually where independent furniture stores pick up steady organic traffic.

I put together a quick SEO health check covering this and a few other fixes - happy to share it, no obligation. Would that be useful?
personalization_basis: Fully verified - live fetch + analyzer run on real HTML

subject: Congrats on the new Zebulon store
body:
Hi,

Congrats on building Zebulon Hardware into the town's go-to spot since 2023 - saw the community backstory on your site, great story.

One thing I noticed: your blog content is split across two places - zebulonhardware.com/blogs/news and a separate trends.zebulonhardware.com subdomain. Search engines generally treat a subdomain as a semi-separate site, so that split can quietly dilute the SEO value both are trying to build. Consolidating onto one would likely help.

I do a quick $29 SEO health check for small local retailers if useful - happy to send it over.
personalization_basis: FULLY_FETCHED — live fetch on 2026-08-31, blog/subdomain split genuinely observed (corrected from earlier unverified draft)
